findings.claim: abc2midi assigns voices to separate SMF tracks/channels and places %%MIDI program on the voice channel; abcjs 6.7.0 emits all program changes on channel 0 while notes may be on other channels.
findings.limits: one synthetic corpus, abcjs bundle exercised in Node via the same getMidiFile entry point

findings.claim: ABC voice labels do not carry instrument timbre. Without an explicit program/plugin mapping, abc2midi emits no program and abcjs emits program 0 on channel 0.
findings.limits: a DAW may apply its own default track instrument; that is a DAW decision, not ABC information

findings.claim: Repeats and first/second endings are flattened to played note events; SMF has no recoverable repeat/ending structure in these outputs.
findings.evidence: case C; both converters produce the same 16-note sequence
findings.limits: abc2midi -PMAR can emit part markers, but that is a converter option and not repeat structure

findings.claim: Dynamics become per-note velocity; accent/tenuto/marcato/staccato/slur semantics are absent or converter-specific.
findings.limits: no automation lanes or continuous dynamics were produced

findings.claim: Chord symbols are realised as generated accompaniment notes (with different voicings/channels per converter), not stored as chord metadata.
findings.limits: abc2midi -NGUI can suppress guitar-chord indications; abcjs getMidiFile had no option in Riff call

findings.claim: abcjs 6.7.0 inline [K:] and [Q:] fields are followed by doubled note durations in getMidiFile; inline meta events are absent.
findings.limits: exact parser cause not established; observed at pinned version only

findings.claim: abc2midi preserves inline meter/key/tempo as MIDI meta at the change tick.
findings.evidence: case B: 3/4 at 1920, key G at 1920, 60 BPM at 1921
findings.limits: tick 1 offset and -1-tick durations need import-side awareness

findings.claim: Tuplets are converted to quantised tick durations; (7 rounds differently between converters (67 vs 69 ticks).
findings.limits: notation structure lost even when notes match

findings.claim: abcjs drops w: lyrics entirely; abc2midi writes text meta, not standard lyric meta by default.
findings.limits: Riff stores lyrics separately; MIDI lyric export would need an explicit option

findings.claim: Defaults and artefacts differ: no-Q default tempo 120 (abc2midi) vs 180 (abcjs); abc2midi starts at tick 1 and shortens durations by 1; abcjs emits initial CC121/64/91/10/7; both add velocity stress.
findings.limits: these may be configurable; the Riff call does not configure them

findings.claim: abc2midi writes the raw 0-127 MIDI program byte; published General MIDI programs are 1-indexed. Raw 73 is GM program 74 (flute).
findings.evidence: cases A/J %%MIDI program values appear as raw bytes
findings.limits: the mapping from a byte to a named instrument is a DAW/soundfont decision; define the numbering convention in the instrument manifest

findings.claim: Unequal-length voices are kept at their authored lengths; abc2midi warns about the short voice, abcjs keeps the same two notes without a warning, and neither pads to a common length.
findings.limits: DAW track extent/layout is an import decision; no common-length normalisation is part of either conversion

limits: Linux x86_64 synthetic corpus; no macOS/Arm64 run
abcjs executed through vendored bundle in Node, not the browser audio context
microtonal ABC, multiple tunes per file, malformed input and large scores not covered
